page.layout: One printed page, title page: Hebrew heading lines at top, centred roman title lines below, a woodcut vignette (tree with banner) in the middle, imprint lines below it. A library stamp at right and an oval seal are not printed text and are omitted.
page.notes: The woodcut vignette shows a tree with a banner reading "NON SOLUM" and a standing figure; it is an engraving, not text. Library stamp (partly legible, "BIBLIOTEK ... HAAG" style) and an oval seal at right are omitted as not printed text. The imprint date is printed as "cIↄIↄc xxxvii" (MDCXXXVII) and is transcribed as printed. The first Hebrew line reads "בבא קמא" and the second "מסכת נזיקין", transcribed from the scan.
